provenance.citation: Pearl, J. (1988). Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems: Networks of Plausible Inference. Morgan Kaufmann.
provenance.locus: Chapter 2 burglary/earthquake/alarm network (canonical parameterization as popularized in Russell & Norvig Fig 14.2): P(B)=0.001, P(E)=0.002, P(A|B,E)=0.95/0.94/0.29/0.001, P(J|A)=0.90/0.05, P(M|A)=0.70/0.01.
provenance.notes: Canonical exact posterior P(Burglary | JohnCalls=t, MaryCalls=t) = 0.284171835... asserted to 1e-6. CPT value order in this implementation: index bits are parent assignments with the FIRST listed parent as the high bit, index 0 = all parents false.
